skill.summary: Free habit tracking, todo, and routines — create and track up to 25 habits, 100 tasks, and 15 routines; schedule reminders and daily briefings across ChatGPT...

latestVersion.changelog:
**Buffy-agent 1.1.7** — Now clearly communicates free usage & generous limits

- Updated description and documentation to highlight that Buffy is now completely free with no paid tiers.
- Clarified limits: up to 25 habits, 100 tasks, 15 routines, and 200 reminders/day.
- Emphasized unlimited access to all features (no paid plans).
- No backend/API or code changes; documentation and user-facing messaging only.
